name: Immaculate Glaiveblade
description: Salute with the blade raised, then lower it into a guard that covers the whole front.

name: Quenched Ferrulecap
description: Cut once from the high salute so the whole school's discipline shows in a single stroke.

name: Vigor Glavesocket
description: Advance in the measured pace taught in the court, each foot placed before the blade moves.

name: Quenched Slicefall
description: Strike twice in the time of one, the second slash following the first on a line beside it.

name: Squall Longedge
description: Turn the foe's blow aside and return the same stroke from the court guard in one flowing motion.

name: Binding Cutbelly
description: Lay blade and shaft along two lines of the foe's weapon and bind it between them.

name: Dunecrook
description: Sweep first the left rim and then the right of a crowd so both flanks are cleared.

name: Destiny Guardlug
description: Run the court's full opening of cut, guard, pace and cut without breaking the measure.

name: Majestic Edgeswing
description: Cleave down from the salute with the court's whole discipline in the stroke and a flood of qi.

name: Heroic Tangheel
description: Draw two crescents of qi from the raised blade, one from each side, and bring them down together as the court's mark.

name: Bladespine Odyssey
description: Circle the foe in two arcs, one wide and one close, as hawks circle prey in pairs.

name: Squall Curvetip
description: Strike first as the lead bird to draw the foe's eyes and guard.

name: Prism Curvecut
description: Thrust second as the trailing bird into the opening the lead cut made.

name: Steel Reave
description: Cross two slashes in an X so the foe cannot parry both.

name: Venom Longcut
description: Cut at the foe's off side to draw his guard before the true stroke comes from the other.

name: Deluge Glaiveblade
description: Beat two blows from the sky aside, first with the blade and then with the butt.

name: Gloomreave
description: Hold the foe fixed with the tip and the shaft in the pairing of a hawk's talons.

name: Seasonglaive
description: Drive the foe with lead strokes and take him with trailing strokes in a paired hunt.

name: Inferno Longcut
description: Dive in two arcs at once, one high and one low, so the foe guards the wrong one.

name: Glavesocket Banner
description: Strike with two stoops of qi from above, the second landing in the wound of the first.

name: Reavecrown
description: Perform the school's rite of two stoops in one stroke, the lead hawk breaking the guard and the trailing hawk the foe.

name: Pealbend
description: Open in the low basin stance and feel where the foe's weight will flow.

name: Bendtriumph
description: Climb the foe's body with the edge as with a slope rising to the rim.

name: Deluge Windrake
description: Step down from a held rim in a smooth drop that carries the weight into the next cut.

name: Sainted Tangheel
description: Hold the shaft low and wide so the blade and butt guard a hollow the foe cannot enter.

name: Cutbelly Decree
description: Cut once with the blade and echo the cut a heartbeat later with the butt.

name: Statute Curvetip
description: Pour qi into the space between you and the foe until he can step only back.

name: Pall Spineedge
description: Parry at the mouth of the attack where it is narrowest and turn it into the basin's rim.

name: Peal Longedge
description: Pull the foe's weapon across the court's line with a short draw that lays his side open.

name: Grand Reave
description: Chain blade and butt in alternate strokes through the foe's guard until it opens at the centre.

name: Thunderclap Ferrulecap
description: Bring the whole blade down into the basin of the foe's guard and split it to the rim.

name: Tempestuous Curvecut
description: Let qi overflow the blade's curve in a crescent that spills across everything on the basin's floor.

name: Gloomcutter
description: Close the basin of the court around the foe with blade and butt crossed so his every movement is hemmed.

name: Nurturing Bladespine
description: Salute the water's edge and read the foe's footing at the first crossing.

name: Crookdecree
description: Cut in the shallows with the edge skimming along the line of the foe's lead arm.

name: Dunereave
description: Take quick even paces over imagined stones, never resting more than a breath on one.

name: Cuttertriumph
description: Slash from midstream with the whole body committed and the current at your back.

name: Venom Windrake
description: Draw the blade low and backward with qi so the foe's feet are pulled from under him.

name: Undaunted Spineedge
description: Hold a guard that treats each blow as a flood to be turned toward the far bank.

name: Tenetglaive
description: Chain seven cuts, each a step further across the foe's front, ending on the far bank.

name: Dauntless Longcut
description: Throw the weight of the whole river through the blade in one downward cleave.

name: Haemalcrook
description: Complete the seventh crossing with a stroke that carries all six earlier cuts in its qi.

name: Tenetcrook
description: Perform the school's whole crossing in one long stroke that passes the foe's guard, body and last defence in turn.

name: Reminiscence Guardlug
description: Stand tall with the blade raised against the open sky and sense the foe's breath as a drift of air.

name: Bedrock Tangheel
description: Cut a crescent along one track and prepare the second to follow it on the next breath.

name: Peal Spineedge
description: Hold the blade high and slanted so blows from above slide off as rain from a roof.

name: Quenched Windrake
description: Send qi down the first track of the stroke so the cut lands as a bright, narrow line.

name: Triumphant Cutbelly
description: Return along the second track in a stroke whose qi trails the first like a shadow.

name: Delugecrook
description: Veil the foe's blade in a soft cloud of qi and slip it past the body.

name: Millstone Guardlug
description: Bind a weapon from above with the blade's belly and hold it there with qi like a hand.

name: Destiny Slicefall
description: Chain cuts down the two tracks in turn, each beginning higher than the last.

name: Bedrock Edgeswing
description: Stoop from the highest guard with the crescent leading and break the foe's stance.

name: Magnificent Curvecut
description: Loose two crescents of azure qi on the two tracks so they cross upon the foe's line.

name: Harmonious Slicefall
description: Perform the school's closing rite, the two tracks of the crescent joined in the single stroke the high azure shows to all.

name: Pealcutter
description: Sit the weight on the dantian's centre and feel the formed core hum through the shaft.

name: Glaivetriumph
description: Cut with the formed core steadying the stroke so the edge neither wavers nor falters.

name: Reavevoyage
description: Advance with the unhurried pace of the court, the core holding the body level.

name: Steel Bladespine
description: Hold the guard with the core's steady qi running through the shaft.

name: Reave Decree
description: Draw a second slash from the core's reserve at once after the first, with no pause.

name: Enshrined Longedge
description: Meet a blow with a pulse from the core that rings the blade and turns the force.

name: Edgeswing Reliquary
description: Hold a weapon in place with the core's weight pressing through the crossed shaft.

name: Solarglaive
description: Sweep a crescent whose qi is drawn from the core along the full rim of reach.

name: Season Glaiveblade
description: Chain strokes at the pace of the core's slow pulse so none is rushed or wasted.

name: Bedrock Spineedge
description: Bring the blade down with the whole core's qi behind it in a cleave that fills the basin of the guard.

name: Squall Tangheel
description: Let the core's qi fall through the blade in a single descending stroke no plain guard can bear.

name: Season Curvetip
description: Perform the court's highest rite, a crescent drawn from the core and shared out between both ends of the glaive.

name: Compassionate Glaiveblade
description: Swear the school's oath aloud and plant the point before the first stroke begins.

name: Squall Guardlug
description: Cut the first stroke as sworn, with no thought for what the foe may do.

name: Vigor Slicefall
description: Advance on bare stone at the school's even pace, never faster than the oath allows.

name: Steel Ferrulecap
description: Slash with the edge bound to the oath so its qi is not spent before the stroke ends.

name: Squall Glavesocket
description: Turn a blow aside from the sworn guard and return the stroke on the same line.

name: Millstone Longedge
description: Press forward over the stone so qi leans upon the foe and holds him in place.

name: Thrallglaive
description: Hold the foe's weapon bound under the blade until the oath has been spoken twice.

name: Choral Curvecut
description: Run cut, guard and press in the order of the oath, never dropping a stroke.

name: Steelbend
description: Bring the blade down hard enough that the stone rings and the guard beneath it splits.

name: Vigorcutter
description: Strike from the highest guard with the oath's whole weight and the qi of the open sky.

name: Resonant Windrake Verdict
description: Perform the school's closing rite, a sworn crescent that carries every stroke of the book in one.

name: Bladespine Reliquary
description: Stand on the sworn line with the shaft level and let nothing push you from it.

name: Bedrock Ferrulecap
description: Cut along the line and no further, so the stroke is cheap to keep and costly to meet.

name: Vigor Curvetip
description: Step forward or back only along the line the school has drawn.

name: Quenched Longcut
description: Surge qi along the line of the edge so its force arrives in one narrow wave.

name: Parity Cutbelly
description: Slip a blow aside with the shaft like wind slipping past a standing stone.

name: Pinning Reave
description: Pin the foe's weapon to the line with qi so it can only move along it.

name: Season Guardlug
description: Chain strokes along one sworn line until the foe is driven off its end.

name: Bedrock Glavesocket
description: Cleave down the line with qi like a cutting wind and split what stands upon it.

name: Squallreave
description: Hold the line through every blow, then loose the stored qi along it in one stroke.

name: Resonant Season Windrake
description: Perform the school's rite of the line, every stroke kept to one bearing and the last stroke sworn to end it.

name: Bendgift
description: Take the bearing on the foe and speak the oath beneath the breath.

name: Thunderclap Curvecut
description: Cut on the bearing with the edge, the eye and the oath all pointing at one place.

name: Delugecutter
description: Advance one oath-length, then another, never altering the bearing between them.

name: Sacrosanct Glaiveblade
description: Hold the guard sworn at the start with the blade across the bearing.

name: Inferno Edgeswing
description: Hew along the held bearing with qi that does not leave the line.

name: Undaunted Ferrulecap
description: Turn the foe's blow in a quick gale of the wrists and return the bearing.

name: Unbending Curvetip
description: Walk the bearing forward with the oath so steadily that the foe must retreat from it.

name: Longcut Seal
description: Rap the foe's blade off its bearing with a short, sharp strike of the heel.

name: Season Longedge
description: Chain strokes upon the bearing in the order the treatise gives, none out of place.

name: Haemal Reave
description: Strike down the foe's own line of bearing and rend his stance at the root.

name: Haemal Glavesocket
description: Bring all the qi of the bearing down the blade in one stroke that no gale could turn.

name: Harmonious Destiny Bladespine
description: Perform the school's rite, the bearing taken, the oath spoken and the stroke made as one act.

name: Crookbenison
description: Set the stance in open field and read the grass and the wind for the foe's approach.

name: Glaiveedict
description: Cut at the full reach of the shaft across the open field with no cover to impede.

name: Striding Spineedge
description: Stride long across the plain keeping the blade level so the pace is also a threat.

name: Bedrock Glaiveblade
description: Slash low through the tall grass so the foe's legs fall before he sees the blade.

name: Steel Cutbelly
description: Raise a thin screen of qi that thickens against each gust of blows.

name: Imperial Edgeswing
description: Sweep qi in slow arcs across the field so no foe may step within a pace.

name: Sigil Slicefall
description: Bind the foe's blade and plant its point in the earth under the glaive's weight.

name: Tenet Tangheel
description: Run across the field in cut, sweep and cut so the foe has no ground to rest.

name: Triumphant Glavesocket
description: Bring the whole blade down on a charging foe so the cleave breaks his charge in one stroke.

name: Exalted Slicefall
description: Let the whole open sky descend as qi through the blade and sweep every foe from the field.

name: Resonant Guardlug Triumph
description: Perform the canon's rite, cuts and sweeps laid across the open ground until no foe stands within it.

name: Interstice Bladespine
description: Stand on the high plateau and sense the wind's pressure for its hint of the foe's next move.

name: Glaivebanner
description: Cut with the wind in the edge so the stroke grows stronger as it travels.

name: Squallbend
description: Take a step as long as a gust and land it as quietly as one.

name: Bedrock Longedge
description: Throw a gust of qi off the crescent that strikes a breath before the steel.

name: Crookvow
description: Turn the blow on a wind of qi that the shaft summons from the plateau.

name: Gloom Tangheel
description: Press upon the foe with the weight of a long wind until his stance sags.

name: Resonant Curvetip
description: Chain cuts, each carried further by the wind of the last, until the foe is driven back.

name: Steelglaive
description: Cleave with a crescent of plateau wind that parts the guard and carries on.

name: Steelcutter
description: Let the long wind gather in the blade and fall as one vast crescent that nothing in its path escapes.

name: Choral Destiny Edgeswing
description: Perform the school's rite, a crescent carried on the long wind from the edge of the plateau to the foe.

name: Cuttergift
description: Seat the weight on the formed core and swear the stroke to its steady pulse.

name: Vigorbend
description: Cut with the core's qi bound to the edge so the stroke carries the oath.

name: Deluge Reave
description: Step on the bearing with the core's weight leading and the feet following.

name: Haemal Curvecut
description: Draw qi from the core in a gale up the shaft and into a single slash.

name: Undefiled Ferrulecap
description: Hold the guard sworn to the core so that it does not give however hard the blow.

name: Peremptory Cutbelly
description: Press upon the foe with the core's qi so steadily that his own qi falters.

name: Subjugating Longcut
description: Pin the foe's weapon beneath the sworn edge with the core's weight through the shaft.

name: Volition Windrake
description: Chain strokes on the core's pulse, each rising like a gale on the last.

name: Thunderclap Curvetip
description: Cleave with the oath and the core together so the stroke breaks both guard and stance.

name: Paramount Tangheel
description: Let the whole core's qi fall down the sworn edge in one stroke that cannot be called back.

name: Orchestral Longedge Decree
description: Perform the school's highest rite, a gale-crescent drawn from the core and sworn to its full length.
